instructions: Read-only view of the lanes of the Cleared service, for an agent working in a checkout of the same project. Before you edit a file, call locked_files with its path from the repository's root: a file a lane holds is being changed on a branch that is not merged yet, so edit it only if the person you work for agrees. list_lanes gives the lanes and their sessions, list_tickets the open tickets. Nothing here changes Cleared.
tool_list_lanes: The lanes: each ticket out of Todo and not Done, its status, whether its flow runs now, the branch and pull request of each service, since when it runs, and its author and reviewer sessions with their phase.
tool_list_tickets: The open tickets, the most recently changed first, {max} at most: id, title, status, labels, services and whether a flow runs. Done tickets only when status asks for them. A ticket's description is never given.
tool_locked_files: The files the lanes hold: edited by a session of a lane or named in its session plan, relative to the repository's root, with the ticket, the session, why (edited, planned) and since when. Give path to check one file, or a folder for the files under it: locked says whether any is held.
arg_status: Only the tickets in this status, as the tracker names it (Todo, In Progress, Done).
arg_path: A file or a folder, relative to the repository's root (src/entries.ts, src/).
arg_service: Only this service of the workspace.
error_path: The path is relative to the repository's root and stays inside it (src/entries.ts).
error_no_flow: The flow is not configured: see CLEARED_V2_PROJECT in v2/README.md.
error_unknown_argument: {name} is not an argument of this tool.
error_argument_type: {name} has the wrong type: see the tool's schema.
error_read: The lanes could not be read. Try again in a moment.
http_unauthorized: A token is needed: the Authorization header, Bearer then the content of the v2-mcp-token file beside ledger.db.
http_peer: This server answers this machine and the tailnet only.
http_origin: A request from a web page is refused.
http_host: This server answers a request addressed to 127.0.0.1, localhost or its tailnet address only.
http_too_large: The body is too large ({max} KB at most).
http_version: This version of the MCP protocol is not supported.
http_unreadable: The MCP token could not be read: see the service's log.
